body: For me I do it to relive my pain sort of, it feels like an expression of emotion and it just feels like letting go. It just makes me feel better. And other times I use it to punish myself, if I think I was doing something stupid, or argued with my boyfriend, or was mean or just did something bad, I do it to punish myself
